$Comment: The first rung of the Headless Horseman's ladder: bring him down once during one season, in his graveyard behind Old Jack. ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED names his fight's encounter script, never a creature, so it holds through his change of form, and MatchMode PREFIX lets his hard ride (Hallows_Eve_Headless_Horseman_Encounter_Hard) count too; every player the fight credits earns it at once, however many shared the kill. Each year's copy pays favor with the Hallowed and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row in Claim, to collect on the achievements page; the row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it out on a server without that mod. The chain kills_hallows_eve_horseman ties the three rungs together in the book.
